usedFor: lusha fills contact gaps, with “Enrich Contacts” and “Enrich Companies” adding details to a profile.

bestTemplate.name: “Enrich Contacts” in lusha

watchOut: “Enrich Contacts” needs an email, a LinkedIn URL, or a name and company, so check one is supplied.
